messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High cross-region routing error rate detected: policy-evaluator 'route-eval' returning stale decisions -> requests from EU being routed to APAC (error spike + latency) :rotating_light:

incident-bot: Summary metrics: 5m error rate +18% vs baseline, p95 latency EU->APAC 2.3s (norm ~120ms), 502/504s observed. Probe divergence detected around 2026-03-15T03:45:20Z.

sara (oncall): acknowledged. paging @miguel @lee. I'm joining the incident channel. I'll triage origin (policy-evaluator service vs control-plane config).

miguel: looking. I see route-eval instances in eu-west1 reporting old policy version (v2026-03-14-hotfix), while control plane shows v2026-03-16. possible deploy partial rollback?

lee: logs show repeated "cached_decision_expired" warnings and then a fallback to nearest-region = apac-south1. stack traces attached in logs.

sara (oncall): are we seeing config-sync failures? kubectl and control-plane both healthy?

miguel: running quick checks:

```
kubectl -n redwood get pods -l app=route-evaluator -o wide
# eu-west1 pods: 3x route-eval-v1 (image v2026-03-14-hotfix)
# eu-west1 pods: 2x route-eval-v2 (image v2026-03-16)
```

miguel: A mix of versions. Some pods never rolled forward (node draining paused?). That could cause mixed decisions.

devops: I see a failed post-deploy hook on two eu-west1 nodes around 03:41Z. Hook tried to migrate KV cache and timed out. Likely left some instances with stale cache and older binary.

support_julie: customer-impact note: Support telemetry shows increased error rates for customers D and F (EU-facing). Some reports of slow interactive features. Ticket volumes doubled for EU region.

sara (oncall): immediate mitigation: 1) take older route-eval pods OOS (scale down by selector) 2) force config-eval fallback to control-plane default policy 3) flush relevant KV caches. We'll coordinate rollback if needed.

lee: executing scale down and drain: `kubectl scale deploy route-evaluator --replicas=2 -n redwood --selector=image=v2026-03-14-hotfix`

lee: drained two stale pods, rolling restart of rest in eu-west1.

oncall-bot: deploy-bot: rolling-restart triggered for deployment route-evaluator in eu-west1 by lee at 2026-03-15T03:53:10Z.

miguel: flushing KV caches via API:

```
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.internal/v1/cache/route-eval/flush?region=eu-west1" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CP_TOKEN"
```

miguel: cache flush accepted.

sara (oncall): temporarily pin EU traffic to eu-west1 primary for 10m via emergency-route policy to prevent accidental APAC fallback. Command: `rbctl policies apply emergency-pin-eu --ttl 600`

devops: applied emergency-pin-eu. Routing probes show route decisions now consistent to eu-west1.

incident-bot: metric update: 2m after mitigation p95 latency EU ~ 180ms, error rate dropping to +4% above baseline.

support_julie: notifying impacted customers with initial incident message; post sent to CS Slack and queued for email follow-up.

sara (oncall): root cause hypothesis: partial post-deploy hook failure left a subset of route-evaluator instances with old binary + stale KV cache. Under load they sometimes served stale decisions that caused a mis-evaluation and fallback to APAC. The control plane considered the rollout successful leading to mixed decision surface.

miguel: next steps: 1) re-run deploy with strict post-hook checks 2) add a gate to prevent traffic routing until all instances confirm cache migration 3) add health check that verifies policy version == control-plane version before acceptance.

lee: opened PR for health-check in route-evaluator: https://github.com/redwood/route-eval/pull/184 (adds policy_version probe and cache_migrated flag).

devops: we will also change the post-deploy hook timeout and add automatic rollback on hook failure. Filing infra ticket INF-2026-118.

sara (oncall): announcements: - kept emergency-pin for now; will monitor for 15m then graduate to normal policy after confirm. - oncall handoff in 40m — @miguel you'll take the next shift if stable.

miguel: happy to take handoff. I'll stay on until 04:40Z.

oncall-bot: oncall-handoff scheduled: sara -> miguel at 04:40Z.

incident-bot: Update: 20m after mitigation all routing probes green, error rate back to baseline. Emergency-pin removed at 04:15Z after confirmation.

sara (oncall): resolution summary for postmortem: "Partial post-deploy hook failure caused heterogeneous route-evaluator fleet in eu-west1. Stale instances served cached decisions leading to cross-region misroutes to APAC. Mitigations: drained and restarted stale pods, flushed KV cache, applied temporary routing pin, rolled restart of fleet. Remediation: improve post-deploy hooks, add policy_version health checks, automatic rollback on hook failure, and pre-rollout gating for cache migration."

support_julie: CS: will send customer impact email to affected accounts with incident summary and ETA for follow-up next week.

miguel: I'll own the remediation work items and link infra ticket INF-2026-118 here.

lee: leaving logs and timeline in runbook: https://redwood.internal/incident/1733333333 (added timestamps and commands).

sara (oncall): handing off fully to miguel. thanks everyone for fast coordination :tada:

miguel: acknowledged, taking ownership. I'll update if anything regresses.

oncall-bot: Incident closed for oncall group; please update postmortem within 48h.
